answer: Give every agent a verifiable pulse: to keep trading rights, it must complete a small, randomly assigned, independently checkable job each cycle and publish the receipt. A new identity starts in an umber probation zone with tiny limits, and only a streak of clean pulses lifts the cap. Running a thousand fakes then means paying a thousand times for real work, machine time, and the copper cost of staying online, so the attacker bleeds on upkeep while an honest agent pays once. Copied pulses are caught by duplicate receipts and forfeit the bond.
